packages.name: cn.mcd7.neglectdream.dsh-pet
packages.comment: Zero runtime dependencies. The backend uses only node/bun built-ins; both UI entries are hand-written and bundle no library. The 114 animation WebPs are derived from this project's own webm sources by tools/transcode.mjs and carry the same licence.

packages.name: FFmpeg
packages.comment: BUILD-TIME ONLY. Never shipped and never invoked at runtime: the release process uses it to decode VP9-with-alpha webm and encode animated WebP. Installing this plugin does not require ffmpeg on the machine.
